create_FloatingArray_constructor: create a FloatingArray from numpy arrays with a boolean mask for NA values
test_FloatingArray_constructor_copy: test the FloatingArray constructor with copy=True to verify data and mask are copied
test_FloatingArray_disallows_float16: test that FloatingArray raises TypeError when constructed with np.float16 dtype
test_pd_array_with_none_nan: test pd.array with None and np.nan values converts them to pd.NA in Float64 dtype
test_pd_array_inferred_dtype: test that pd.array infers Float32Dtype from float32 numpy arrays and Float64Dtype from lists
test_pd_array_error_invalid_values: test that pd.array raises TypeError or ValueError for invalid input values like strings or dicts
test_FloatingArray_from_sequence: test FloatingArray._from_sequence to construct from a list of string float values
test_from_arrow_nan_vs_none: test Float64Dtype.__from_arrow__ to verify NaN and None handling with pyarrow arrays
test_pd_array_bool_to_float: test pd.array converts boolean lists to Float64 dtype with corresponding integer values
test_series_from_float_array: test constructing a pandas Series from a FloatingArray with Float64 dtype
